content: Ongoing clinical trials are being conducted to further investigate the effects of teplizumab and other pharmacologic interventions aimed at delaying the onset of type 1 diabetes in individuals who exhibit autoimmune markers and are at a high risk of disease progression. It is critically important to perform individualized risk assessments, as the efficacy of preventive measures can vary significantly between individuals. The ultimate objective is to develop and provide personalized recommendations based on each person’s unique risk factors, with the aim of delaying the onset or progression of type 1 diabetes for as long as possible.
